sourceWindow.qualification: Conservative wall-clock envelope from same original job ACK creation and terminal publication, supported by bootstrap-intent record; not an exact wall-clock timestamp for posix_spawn. No timezone inferred from ps lstart and no guessed monotonic-to-epoch conversion.

selectorConcept.label: exact QA label with token boundary check

requiredBeforeRunnable: Observed exact installed public log tool path, ordinary metadata/wholeSHA and its own bounded help output; none is yet held for this tool.
Actual support for bounded start/end timestamps, predicate and machine-readable style must be read, not inferred from general documentation.
A separately reviewed owner-custody wrapper must retain at most the fixed window/matching label output and never serialize raw or unknown-message hashes.

publicAppleReference.claim: Apple documents the log tool start/end and predicate options as a way to narrow by recorded timestamps and process/message filters.
publicAppleReference.scope: Reference only, not installed path/ABI/flag qualification.

boundedHelpProposal.reason: Do not dispatch until this fixed tool is admitted and a helper/custody carrier is reviewed.

eventProjectionContract.unknown: Count only; do not expose unknown body, path, hash, command line or credential. No hit cannot prove no earlier error or no retained log.
eventProjectionContract.categoriesNotYetQualified: Closed message templates must be based on reviewed installed output/schema; no arbitrary text classifier is currently admitted.
